title: Bar Drop Fizzy Orange 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Fizzy Orange by Drop captures the zesty excitement of orange soda. It bursts with the taste of sun-ripened oranges, balancing citric tartness with sugary juice notes. The profile is elevated by a sparkling, effervescent quality that mimics the sensation of carbonation, making it a lively choice for citrus lovers. The unique 40% VG / 60% PG ratio is perfect for citrus profiles, ensuring the sharp orange notes are delivered with maximum clarity and zest. Designed for use in MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) pod kits, the nicotine salt formula offers quick satisfaction and a smooth draw in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts are brought to you by Drop and are manufactured right here in the UK. Drop’s collections focus on fabulously fruity flavours that are achingly authentic and blend familiar favourites with unique profiles.
